senses.gloss: (√גב to arch, cave, curve; cmp. √כף, גף &c.) to curve. *Pes. 42ᵃ bot. three things … גּוֹבְבִין את הקומה Ar. (ed. כופפין; Erub. 55ᵇ bot. ed. Sonc. גופפין) curve the erect stature (make man’s back high).
to heap up, pile, esp. to gather twigs, straw &c.; to rake.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 9:6">Shebi. IX, 6</cite> <he>המְגַבֵּב ביבש</he> he who gathers dry plants, leaves &c., (opp. <cite ref="M01623"><he>מלקט</he></cite>, of green plants).
B. Kam. 101ᵇ; Succ. 40ᵃ גִּיבְּבָן, v. חִבָּה II. Y. Yeb. VIII, 8ᵈ bot.; a. fr.—Trnsf. (with or sub. דברים) to pick up frivolous arguments.

<cite ref="Yoma 76a:5">Yoma 76ᵃ</cite> <he>עד מתי אתה מְגַבֵּב דברים ומביא עלינו</he> (Ms. a. Ar. omit <he>דברים</he>) how long wilt thou rake words together and bring them up against us (i.e. what authority have you for your assertion)?; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab. ch. IV, Par. 4 <he>מגבב ומביא …</he> (Mekh. B’shall., Vayas. 3 <he>מתמה</he>).
